notes.title: Demo Update 1.0 & Achievements! 🎮 🏆
notes.content:
Hello, we present to you the [b]Housebreaker Demo Update 1.0!
[/b]
First, we want to thank you for contributing to Steam Next Fest: June 2022! What is your opinion on Housebreaker? Did you like the story presented? Do you have comments or concerns about the game? 

We are waiting for your feedback in the comments section!

We try to provide you with such a product so that you can only benefit from the game and encounter as few errors as possible! Here is a list of the changes and fixes made:

[url=https://i.imgur.com/0qz8dvR.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36880963/4362e239790c1ba350580c2682a34bafa9182ef2.png[/img][/url]

Additionally, Steam Achievements were introduced to the demo version to make the gameplay more enjoyable for players. We also decided on 3 secrets, so if someone has already discovered the secret room, feel free to share your opinion!

[url=https://i.imgur.com/wXyo2Un.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36880963/9f9d4c40ab994d0bb94fe67ddba8b328a081b033.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Housebreaker - A NEW BEGINNING!
notes.content:
Welcome, all players!

We wanted to inform you about the significant changes that await our production and company. First of all, the Car Thief Simulator, from now on, takes a new direction. It will be a Housebreaker, about a withdrawn man who, wanting to get rich, decides to become a burglar who targets houses with specific goals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36880963/65a3de9e195eea8c74319695d2683a7e10411fa9.png[/img]

Thanks to this change, we decided to participate in the Steam Next Fest: June 2022. We want to provide you with the best possible experience, so from June 13, 2022, you will have the opportunity to test the demo version. We count on your feedback, we try our best for you. Thanks to your comments, we will be able to provide you with a final product that will meet the requirements of all players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36880963/91d23b928faf31a8e8083b05773113ff5e950cae.png[/img]

Additionally, we have new IP productions planned, so we have a lot of work to do. We will not stand still, we will do our best to make you hear about us many times!

We hope that our contribution will translate into many demanding players. We are ready for new challenges!
See you at the Steam Next Fest: June 2022!

notes.title: Devlog#03: Shop.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36880963/4767792728f47db8aff77caf4fd918b4cfc7d4e1.jpg[/img]

Not every car in Car Thief Simulator is ready to drive. If you want to own a vehicle that works, and sell it for more money, you will have to invest in parts. Suspension springs, brake pads, car batteries no longer needed? Sell them, earn money and reach your new goals.
